dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
『なにか飲み物もってくるから、適当にくつろ
　いでて』
dialogues.en: "Please make yourself at home. I'll bring some drinks."
dialogues.text: "Please make yourself at home. I'll bring some drinks."

dialogues.jp: そう言ってさくらが襖の向こうに消えた。
dialogues.en: Sakura disappears behind the sliding door as she says so.
dialogues.text: Sakura disappears behind the sliding door as she says so.

dialogues.jp: 「はぁ」
dialogues.en: "Sure..."
dialogues.text: "Sure..."

dialogues.jp: なんとなく、予想を越えた部屋に驚く。
dialogues.en: I'm amazed at the room.
dialogues.text: I'm amazed at the room.

dialogues.jp: 驚くほどなにもない。
dialogues.en: What surprises me is that there's nothing in here.
dialogues.text: What surprises me is that there's nothing in here.

dialogues.jp:
いや、あるといえばあるのだが、和洋折衷と言
うのかなんと言うのか……。
dialogues.en:
Well, there's some things, but they're a blending of
Japanese and Western elements, I guess...
dialogues.text:
Well, there's some things, but they're a blending of
Japanese and Western elements, I guess...

dialogues.jp:
鏡台の横にコンビニに置いてあるコピー機みた
いな機械があり、書生机の上にパソコンがある。
dialogues.en:
There is a big photocopier like you sometimes see in a
convenience store next to the dresser, and a computer next
to the old Japanese desk.
dialogues.text:
There is a big photocopier like you sometimes see in a
convenience store next to the dresser, and a computer next
to the old Japanese desk.

dialogues.jp:
それらは作り途中の夜店の水飴のような、複雑
な線で結ばれている。
dialogues.en:
They look weird beside each other, like a candy store open
at night.
dialogues.text:
They look weird beside each other, like a candy store open
at night.

dialogues.jp:
それ以外は整頓されている――ではなく、とに
かくモノがない。
dialogues.en:
Other than that, it's tidy... Or to be precise, there is
hardly anything in the room.
dialogues.text:
Other than that, it's tidy... Or to be precise, there is
hardly anything in the room.

dialogues.jp: 試しに本棚を見てみた。
dialogues.en: I look at the bookcase.
dialogues.text: I look at the bookcase.

dialogues.jp:
どれも俺には馴染みのない背の厚さだが、百科
事典とコンピュータ関係の専門書らしい。
dialogues.en:
I'm not familiar with any books, but they look like
encyclopedias and books about computers.
dialogues.text:
I'm not familiar with any books, but they look like
encyclopedias and books about computers.

dialogues.jp:
英語か何語か知らないが、タイトルすら読めな
い本も少なくない。
dialogues.en:
There are many books whose titles I can't even read, because
they're in English or other languages.
dialogues.text:
There are many books whose titles I can't even read, because
they're in English or other languages.

dialogues.jp: 「まじか……」
dialogues.en: "You're kidding me..."
dialogues.text: "You're kidding me..."

dialogues.jp: 適当にくつろげ、か。
dialogues.en: Did she tell me to feel at home?
dialogues.text: Did she tell me to feel at home?

dialogues.jp:
この部屋で俺がとれる行動は、辞典を枕に寝る
ことしかないんじゃないのかと思う。
dialogues.en:
How I can relax in this room? The only thing I can think of
doing in this room is to sleep using one of encyclopedias as
a pillow.
dialogues.text:
How I can relax in this room? The only thing I can think of
doing in this room is to sleep using one of encyclopedias as
a pillow.

dialogues.jp:
もしくは、このパソコンでＨな画像を見ること
くらいだろうか。
dialogues.en: Or I could look up porn sites on this computer.
dialogues.text: Or I could look up porn sites on this computer.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「おまった〜？」
dialogues.en: "Thanks for waiting~."
dialogues.text: "Thanks for waiting~."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「なんだその珍奇な言葉は……」
dialogues.en: "What the heck did you say?"
dialogues.text: "What the heck did you say?"

dialogues.jp: 縁側に面した廊下から現れたさくらに｛うめ／呻｝く。
dialogues.en: I moaned as Sakura appeared from the veranda.
dialogues.text: I moaned as Sakura appeared from the veranda.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うにゃ？　おまった〜？」
dialogues.en: "Hmm? Waited long?"
dialogues.text: "Hmm? Waited long?"

dialogues.jp:
ジュースらしいグラスの載った盆を畳において、
さくらが首をかしげて座る。
dialogues.en:
Sakura sits down, cocking her head to the side, putting the
tray with glasses of juice on the tatami mat.
dialogues.text:
Sakura sits down, cocking her head to the side, putting the
tray with glasses of juice on the tatami mat.

dialogues.jp: 「待ってない待ってない」
dialogues.en: "I didn't wait long."
dialogues.text: "I didn't wait long."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「あはははは、なんか読みたい本とかあったの？
　貸したげるよ」
dialogues.en:
"Hahahaha, did you find any interesting books you might
like? You can borrow some."
dialogues.text:
"Hahahaha, did you find any interesting books you might
like? You can borrow some."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「いや、いい」
dialogues.en: "No, it's okay."
dialogues.text: "No, it's okay."

dialogues.jp: 返却が何年後になるか分からん。
dialogues.en: Who knows when I'd return her book if I borrow it.
dialogues.text: Who knows when I'd return her book if I borrow it.

dialogues.jp: 「しかし、なにもない部屋だな」
dialogues.en: "Anyway, there's nothing in the room."
dialogues.text: "Anyway, there's nothing in the room."

dialogues.jp: 部屋を見渡しながら呟く。
dialogues.en: I mumble, looking around.
dialogues.text: I mumble, looking around.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「この家は、できる限り昔のままにしてあるか
　ら」
dialogues.en: "I try to keep the house as it used to be."
dialogues.text: "I try to keep the house as it used to be."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「昔のままって、ばあちゃんが居た頃のまま？」
dialogues.en: "You mean like when grandma was alive?"
dialogues.text: "You mean like when grandma was alive?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「そう。お兄ちゃんとボクが出会った頃のまま」
dialogues.en: "Yes. This is exactly the same as when I met you."
dialogues.text: "Yes. This is exactly the same as when I met you."

dialogues.jp: さくらが、小さく微笑む。
dialogues.en: Sakura smiles a little.
dialogues.text: Sakura smiles a little.

dialogues.jp: 「はぁ……かったる」
dialogues.en: "Haah... what a pain in the neck."
dialogues.text: "Haah... what a pain in the neck."

dialogues.jp: 畳に座りながら、その手触りを楽しむ。
dialogues.en: I enjoy the feeling of tatami mats as I sit on them.
dialogues.text: I enjoy the feeling of tatami mats as I sit on them.

dialogues.jp: 「話をするしかないのかな？」
dialogues.en: "Do we have to talk now?"
dialogues.text: "Do we have to talk now?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「話をすることが出来るんだよ」
dialogues.en: "We can talk as much as we want now."
dialogues.text: "We can talk as much as we want now."

dialogues.jp: さくらが言い直して、にこり、と笑う。
dialogues.en: Sakura matched her words to mine with a smile.
dialogues.text: Sakura matched her words to mine with a smile.

dialogues.jp: 「６年分か。時間がかかるな」
dialogues.en:
"We have six years to catch up. It'll take a long time,
though."
dialogues.text:
"We have six years to catch up. It'll take a long time,
though."

dialogues.jp: 肘をついて寝転びながら、俺も笑う。
dialogues.en: I laugh with her as I lie down on my elbow.
dialogues.text: I laugh with her as I lie down on my elbow.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「１２年分だよ」
dialogues.en: "Twelve years."
dialogues.text: "Twelve years."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "Hm?"
dialogues.text: "Hm?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「ボクとお兄ちゃんの６年間だから。６年かけ
　るふたり分で１２年分」
dialogues.en:
"Six years for me and another six years for you, oniichan.
So there are twelve years altogether."
dialogues.text:
"Six years for me and another six years for you, oniichan.
So there are twelve years altogether."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「そうか」
dialogues.en: "I see."
dialogues.text: "I see."

dialogues.jp: 自分のことを語るのか。
dialogues.en: I've got to tell her my story.
dialogues.text: I've got to tell her my story.

dialogues.jp:
しかし、そうすると音夢のことも話さなくては
いけない。
dialogues.en: In that case, I have to talk about Nemu, too.
dialogues.text: In that case, I have to talk about Nemu, too.

dialogues.jp: 長い話になる――。
dialogues.en: It's going to be a long story.
dialogues.text: It's going to be a long story.

dialogues.jp: そして――。
「かったるいな」
dialogues.en: "It's a pain in the neck."
dialogues.text: "It's a pain in the neck."

dialogues.jp: 静かにまぶたを閉じる。
dialogues.en: I close my eyes quietly.
dialogues.text: I close my eyes quietly.

dialogues.jp: まだ高い日が、まぶたを白く染める。
dialogues.en: The sunlight warms my eyelids.
dialogues.text: The sunlight warms my eyelids.

dialogues.jp:
木々のざわめき。舞い散る桜の１枚１枚がイメー
ジ出来た。
dialogues.en:
The sound of leaves conjures up images, each cherry blossom
petal flying high.
dialogues.text:
The sound of leaves conjures up images, each cherry blossom
petal flying high.

dialogues.jp:
「そういうわけで……俺は睡眠学習のノリで話
　を聞くことにするよ」
dialogues.en:
"Okay, then... I'm ready to listen to your story in
sleep-learning mode."
dialogues.text:
"Okay, then... I'm ready to listen to your story in
sleep-learning mode."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うにゃぁ！！」

さくらの叫びを聞きながら、畳の匂いをかぎな
がら、俺は昼寝をすることにした。
dialogues.en:
I'm going to take a nap, smelling tatami mats and listening
to Sakura shout.
dialogues.text:
I'm going to take a nap, smelling tatami mats and listening
to Sakura shout.

dialogues.jp: ◆畳の匂い◆
dialogues.en: ◆The smell of tatami mats◆
dialogues.text: ◆The smell of tatami mats◆

dialogues.jp:
純和風のさくらの家。なんとなく、ばあちゃん
との思い出のために心がなごんでいく。
dialogues.en:
Sakura's house is decorated in Japanese style. I feel
relaxed remembering my grandma.
dialogues.text:
Sakura's house is decorated in Japanese style. I feel
relaxed remembering my grandma.

dialogues.jp:
さくらは俺と話がしたかったらしいけど、俺は
そのまま眠りに落ちた。
dialogues.en: Sakura wanted to talk with me, but I drifted off to sleep.
dialogues.text: Sakura wanted to talk with me, but I drifted off to sleep.
